visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a large build, wearing a black chef's hat and a black chef's jacket, stands in a kitchen, pointing toward the camera. Behind him are wooden shelves with kitchen supplies and a pink panda plush. (2) A close-up shot of a silver nameplate on a wooden surface that identifies the man as a famous chef's grandson. (3) The man throws off an outer jacket and puts on a black apron, tying it behind his back with dramatic gestures. Text overlays appear at the bottom. (4) The man opens a cardboard food container to reveal a pasta dish. He begins eating the pasta vigorously with a fork, showing several different varieties including green pesto and red tomato sauce. (5) In a series of fast cuts, he is seen cooking in the kitchen, boiling noodles in a pot, pouring oil into a pan, and stirring ingredients with a wooden spatula. (6) He presents a large plate of clam pasta to the camera, holding it with both hands. (7) An graphic poster appears featuring the man and another chef in white, with event details and a foodpanda logo. (8) The man holds a pink panda plush and eats more pasta while mobile app UI overlays appear on the screen, demonstrating how to use a digital platform.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-tempo electronic music begins as a man shouts a greeting in a high-arousal, energetic tone. A dull thud is heard as he tosses a jacket, followed by a metallic click. (2) The man continues speaking rapidly over the driving synth beat. A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound occurs as the visual scene shifts. (3) Slurping sounds and percussive chewing noises are prominent as the man eats pasta, interspersed with quick electronic rhythmic accents. (4) The sound of a spatula scraping a metal pan and the sizzle of liquid being poured into hot oil are layered with the man's shouting narrative. (5) A distinct 'ding' bell sound effects plays when the man mentions forgetting an ingredient. (6) High-pitched digital UI bubble pops and app notification chimes accompany the final promotional section where the man speaks directly to the audience about an event.
